creation.semantics: Each Dialog instance receives a new router instance during onCreate.

registration.replacement: HashMap.put replaces the previous value for the same registration name on this router instance.
registration.removal: No remove, unregister, or clear method exists on com.tencent.open.b in this APK. A fresh router replaces the whole registry only when a new Dialog instance runs c.onCreate; normal Dialog disposal makes the instance unreachable.

dispatch_entry.receiver: the same router instance whose registry is consulted (p0 / this)
dispatch_entry.parse: Append '/#', split on '/', require at least 6 elements; index 2 is registry name, index 3 is method name, indices 4 through size-2 are URL-decoded arguments.
dispatch_entry.callback_webview: The WebView argument is stored weakly in Lcom/tencent/open/b$a;->a:Ljava/lang/ref/WeakReference; and is the only WebView used for javascript: callback loadUrl calls.
dispatch_entry.result: false for null/wrong scheme/short message; true after a syntactically accepted dispatch attempt, including unknown object or method.

legacy_callback.flow: logs only; it does not invoke the router in this APK

installed_transport.router_alias: Inherited field Lcom/tencent/open/c;->jsBridge:Lcom/tencent/open/b; on the same TDialog instance
installed_transport.webview_creation_attach: Lcom/tencent/open/TDialog;->a()V constructs field i, adds it to field h's container, and calls Dialog.setContentView(h).
installed_transport.identity_constraint: Bind registry endpoints only to the WebView passed as argument 0 to dispatch on this same router instance. For TDialog that argument is exactly this.i. Do not merge another Dialog's jsBridge registry, JsListener, or WebView merely because class and registration strings match.

reflection.selection: First enumerated declared method whose name equals the URI method segment and whose parameter count equals the decoded argument count.
reflection.inheritance: Inherited methods are excluded because getDeclaredMethods(), not getMethods(), is used. The base call/customCallback methods are therefore not endpoints for a JsListener registration.
reflection.accessibility: No Method.setAccessible(true) call exists. Non-public selected methods can fail reflective access and are caught; the concrete TDialog.JsListener endpoints are public in DEX.
reflection.parameter_semantics: Every supplied argument is a URL-decoded java.lang.String. No type inspection or conversion is performed. A selected endpoint succeeds only if Method.invoke can accept those String objects (or there are zero arguments); incompatible primitive or unrelated reference parameters fail and enter the exception path.
reflection.arity_limit: The invoke ladder explicitly supplies 0 through 6 String arguments. A list larger than 6 falls through the same final branch and still supplies only indices 0..5, causing an arity/invocation failure for a method selected with a larger parameter count.
reflection.overloads: Overloads are distinguished only by method name and parameter count. Same-name/same-arity overloads are ambiguous because reflection enumeration order is not constrained and parameter types are ignored.
reflection.return_semantics: After invocation, non-void results are sent only when callback is non-null and customCallback() returns true. Lcom/tencent/open/b$b;->customCallback()Z returns false and TDialog.JsListener does not override it, so its return values are ignored. All registered TDialog.JsListener endpoints return void.
reflection.unknown_semantics: No matching method calls callback.a(), producing the 'no such method' JavaScript callback.
reflection.exception_semantics: Any Exception during lookup invocation/conversion/access is logged and callback.a() is invoked; it does not dispatch another overload.

model_rule.bind: registration object -> same router registry entry -> dispatch receiver router -> dispatch WebView argument
model_rule.forbidden_join: Never join endpoints by registration name alone, Dialog class alone, or global framework type. Separate TDialog instances have separate router maps and WebViews.
